title: It's Hard To Be Humble
lyrics_plain:
Oh Lord, It's Hard to be Humble
when you're perfect in every way
I can't wait to look in the mirror,
'cos I get better lookin' each day
To know me is to love me,
I must be a hell of a man
Oh Lord, It's Hard To Be Humble
But I'm doin' the best that I can.
I used to have a girl friend,
but I guess she just couldn't compete.
With all of these love starved women,
who keep clamouring at my feet.
Well I prob'ly could find me another
But I guess they're all in awe of me.
Who cares I never get lonesome
'cos I treasure my own company.
Oh Lord, It's Hard to be Humble
when you're perfect in every way
I can't wait to look in the mirror,
'cos I get better lookin' each day
To know me is to love me,
I must be a hell of a man
Oh Lord, It's Hard To Be Humble
But I'm doin' the best that I can.
I guess you could say that I'm a loner
a cowboy outlaw tough and proud.
Oh I could have lots o' friends
if I wanted.
but then I wouldn't stand out
from the crowd.
Some folks say that I'm egotistical
Hell I don't even know what that means.
I guess it has somethin' to do
with the way that I fill out
my skin tight blue jeans.

I must be a hell of a man

But I'm doin' the best that I can.
We're doin' the best that we can.
